method: Read all nine actual card files, resolve every claim pointer, independently reopen each cited institutional source, compare with manifest-merged index and js/card.js date rendering. No card edits. Root authorized reviewer to apply limited source-confirmed editorial and mapping repairs after author freeze; hashes updated after edits.
independenceLimit: Independent reading, not independent historical corroboration: some sources are the same works used by the author.
sharedIssue: js/card.js presents civ.from/to as unlabeled date span. Circa alone does not explain snapshot coverage. Its year clamp also prevents viewing Minoan dated examples and early Northumbrian events at the years documented in these cards.
